description: Add to an existing Notion page (pageId or its link, from list_notion_pages): markdown content, a swipefileCollection, or includeSchedule:true, at the END by default. Markdown content can instead go at:'start', or after / before a block: pass that block's text copied exactly from the page with its markdown ("## Action items"). Nothing already on the page changes. Free.

after.description: exact page text of the block to add after

at.description: start or end of the page (default end)

before.description: exact page text of the block to add before

includeSchedule.description: true appends the scheduled posts too

swipefileCollection.description: swipefile collection name or id to append, with each ad's creative, copy, dates and link

name: append_to_notion_page
title: Add to a Notion page
